title: Classify and encode the exact correlated P104 producer entrance
body:
## Why this is needed

[PR #3426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3426) characterises ideal correlated admission at the first P104 collector cut, but leaves the actual stagewise integrality conditions open. Final cancellation alone does not ensure that the literal fractional ADDs and native pairs execute exactly.

This package, `research/p104-stagewise-entrance`, answers that handoff on the authenticated **257-event producer dependency cone**. It follows the [claim in Discussion #2750](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009685), task `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 6, with the explicit scope change retained in `TASK.json`. The base is canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## What this contributes

### 1. A necessary-and-sufficient stagewise entrance

All 58 initial banks belong to the Gaussian Newton lattice `B9`, with arbitrary admitted dirty D/Q inputs. Chronological partial sums separate the 52 Y banks into **32 intervals without a D transport, 15 intervals with one actual rank-one D transport, and five terminal coordinates**.

Writing `pi = 1+i`, the two nonterminal weighted Newton profiles have exponents `max(4-|S|,0)` and `max(4-|S\{0}|,0)`, pulled back through their actual frame histories. The terminal condition is `4B9`. The complete entrance has index

```text
2^(32*187 + 15*280 + 5*2048) = 2^20424
```

inside `B9^52`. It is strictly between `(4B9)^52` and the predecessor's ideal terminal-only entrance, adding an index factor of `2^10184` beyond the latter. The full Gaussian quotient and the algebraic necessity/sufficiency proof are supplied.

The contract requires integral fractional-ADD increments, every literal native pair to equal its ideal complex-linear gate, and all six cut arrays in `B9`. It permits intermediate arrays outside `B9`. It does not classify genuinely rounded paths with later cancellation or execute the 1,768 omitted events of the full 2,025-event prefix.

### 2. A reversible parameterisation of the entire entrance

An explicit encoder maps **52 owned arbitrary Gaussian coefficient banks** onto the complete admitted Y module. It executes each local Newton/diagonal profile, the actual inverse frame paths and extra inverse right wrappers, then groupwise backward differences. Its inverse reconstructs partial sums and rejects unavailable exact divisions. The six already admitted dirty D/Q banks remain separate inputs.

This changes the numerical source coordinates. A paid caller still needs an input/output intertwiner, a returned-source and frame contract, and ownership/restoration accounting. The Python references do not claim a measured physical in-place implementation.

### 3. An explicit logical cost and width bill

The preparation uses 158 native occurrences of total rank 281, 71,936 native pairs, 331 wrappers, and 159,020 direct Gaussian payload SWAPs.

| Category | Encoder | Decoder |
|---|---:|---:|
| Real ADD/subtract subtotal before SWAP and phase lowering | 1,133,456 | 1,123,216 |
| Native real floor-halves | 287,744 | 287,744 |
| Additional exact real halves | 0 | 270,224 |

All actual wrapper phases and movement are separately itemised. The optional fully lowered component-arithmetic schedule explicitly permits source-minus-target overwrites, so it is not the repository's stricter ADD tariff. Conservative work bounds are `612480H < 2^20 H` for coefficient height `H`, and `98304J < 2^17 J` for decoding admitted Y height `J`, plus signed storage.

These are constructive upper bounds. Physical copies, routes, control, owners, widths of the surrounding caller, and the full recursive bill remain unpriced. The conditional unchanged-profile **599/584** stop remains in force. No supplier or improved kappa is claimed.

## Evidence and reproduction

The package contains the proof, explicit codec, primary literal evaluator, separately written independent evaluator, independent source-cost counter, strict receipt checks, retained sources, and three concrete next questions.

- Both implementations construct a dense signed 58-bank fixture through different actual paths, agree on initial and cut hashes, and each checks all six full-array cut formulae. All **90,624 literal/ideal native pairs** and **52 exact quarter reads** pass; all 52 codec roundtrips pass.
- Every one of the 512 basis directions in each nonterminal local profile receives an independent threshold check. The written proof supplies universal necessity/sufficiency; these finite checks do not substitute for it.
- Ideal-admitted negative controls fail first at the quarter at event **1087** and the native pair at event **1089**, with matching module rejection and separately evaluated failure kinds. The credited [PR #3426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3426) paired-64 family passes the cone with zero cut.
- Normal and optimised registered Python 3.12.14 replays pass with the same complete typed receipt. Metadata and source pins pass. Separate optimised CLI processes reject a missing WORD, a corrupt WORD, and Boolean `true` replacing integer `1` in the receipt, each for its intended reason.
- The tested-tree read-only Git-free export passes with Git unavailable. All 26 exported files, including its manifest, retain their hashes, sizes, modes, inodes, and modification times.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-stagewise-entrance
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-stagewise-entrance --check-source-history
```

Public head **`4e4b08c689242f7f3be2e5e08dc1ae8d728ff920`**, tree **`908f3d09759d093df159d2fa8918e87f1aa72277`**, is byte-identical to the locally replayed tree. The public commit and strict source-history check pass for all **25 package/input files**, and its portable export passes inventory verification. All 25 public exported source files match the Git-free replayed export byte for byte; only its commit-identifying export manifest differs. The four copied predecessor sources are retained byte for byte in public ancestor `091386d3632eb084eb264b293d6b7eb520fe2e3b`.

Receipt file SHA-256 is `91b4f644189bacdd19952e360d55d3738a915e50cf98001baf7f47fda54bd561`; its canonical scientific digest is `f2ec5be0707ab21f9f7fae68ebb91e862c8ee8eff094fc2e62b37af39b9a0f49`. Complete native covariance is inherited from [PR #3416](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3416) and is not recertified here. No independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Hosted CI is not yet claimed.

## Coordination, concurrent work, and credit

The submission checkpoint completed all four open-PR pages, **368 records**, with unchanged main. A final bounded delta check at **02:49:58 UTC, 18 October 2026**, read the 11 new bodies [PR #3455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3455)–[PR #3465](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3465) through the unchanged [PR #3454](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3454) boundary. Targeted Discussion #2750 and #1166 refreshes were read. This is incomplete for the full Discussion corpus, historical diffs, and unpublished work, and is not a novelty certificate.

Nick Petalas's concurrent [PR #3449](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3449), head `5cb2ff187a27de1cbd1a37933f7228b35b15702b`, independently proves the sharp index-280 profile for the particular Y27/Y26 rank-one window. Its exact proof was read at submission and agrees with our local profile. Credit is explicit, with no priority claim. This PR adds the general 58-bank entrance, all 52 independent partial-sum coordinates, the actual-path encoder/inverse, and their direct invoice.

Hiroki Kumazaki's [PR #3446](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3446) recipient closure, Nick Petalas's [PR #3448](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3448) all-depth product entrance, and the newer [PR #3462](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3462) normalised omitted-endpoint completion are complementary. Their full proofs and executables were not replayed here; their physical and caller obligations remain separate.

Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI assistance from four concurrent mathematical, implementation, and coordination agents. Credit remains with ywz65/[PR #2586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2586), Arham Tahir/[PR #2665](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2665), Clear1nsight/[PR #3382](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3382)/[PR #3423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3423), Nick Petalas/[PR #3416](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3416)/[PR #3426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3426) and concurrent [PR #3449](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3449), Tekalign/[PR #3025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3025)/[PR #3218](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3218), Ross Richardson/[PR #3068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3068), and Jose Manuel and Vasek W for the inherited unchanged-profile stop. Apache-2.0 and predecessor notices are retained.

## Open obligations

The next useful steps are a named caller with proved coordinate and return equations, admission for its additional histories outside this cone, and a changed fully charged supplier screen. The selected frontier is unchanged. This contribution releases its scoped claim without reserving any of those follow-ups.
